title: Salary Negotiation Script During the Offer Call
script: Welcome to TalentXcel Career Intelligence. The exact words to say when receiving a verbal job offer. Top priorities include "I am thrilled with the team and mission.", "Let me review the formal offer in writing.", and "I will circle back with my thoughts tomorrow.". Critical Rule reaches Never Accept On The Call. Explore verified opportunities at talentxcel dot com today.
